notes: Architecture-controlled paths for Architecture v1.0. Changes to these locations are protected: they require an Architecture Change Request (ACR) and must not be carried silently by an implementation PR. The check-protected command fails the build when a changed file matches a pattern below. The full ACR template/lifecycle is owned by ARCH-WF-002; until it lands, ANY protected-path change is rejected. This manifest is itself architecture-controlled.
